purpose: Independent v0.6.0 repo/actor/public-fetch/alignment smoke snapshot; not a role, skill, fit, hiring, or industry benchmark.

measurement_policy.local_git: exact values are expected only for the recorded repository snapshot
measurement_policy.public_forge: moving source; compare source URL, fetched status, response digest, and invariants
measurement_policy.personal_data: raw email and local absolute paths are intentionally excluded

use_for: contributors are not a complete identity join
merge and empty commits are excluded from GitHub contributor statistics
commits are not linked when the author email is not connected to a GitHub account
public repository and declared license/source context
public repository and frontend-tooling source context

expect: repo command emits report-v2 with subject.kind=repo and repo activity
actor --all and actor --top emit actor collections with ranking=false
actor command can select one observed actor without a required identity.toml
repo activity is not narrowed to one actor
repo_commits and human_commit_count must identify whether merge commits are included
attributed_commit_count, merge_count, and human_commit_count must reconcile without contradictory unresolved counts
actor commit_count must state whether it includes merge commits
scenarios.reason: The report exposes a repo activity population without making the actor attribution population (which includes merges) explicit enough for a non-engineer to reconcile it.

expect: public contributor data is joined to commit authors by a documented stable key or commit SHA
a successful HTTP 200 with handles does not by itself prove identity attachment
named-public output must expose attachment coverage
scenarios.reason: The contributors endpoint returns login keys, while the current attribution join looks up lower-cased Git author email; fetched handles therefore do not attach to observed actors.

expect: named-public is either non-empty with attachment evidence or exits/labels not_available
exit 0 with observed_count=0 must not look like a successful named contribution
the directory written by repo --actors can be consumed by align --actor-dir
actor cards contain enough report-v2 provenance and metric basis for alignment

cloudflare-os.error: actor-dir needs actor-report.json (report-v2) or report-v2 actor JSON files

scenarios.reason: The formal single actor-report path works, but the collection produced by repo --actors is not directly consumable by the advertised actor-dir alignment path.

expect: repo --actors Markdown makes the actor population visible or links to each actor card
a non-engineer can distinguish repository totals from actor totals without opening raw JSON
scenarios.reason: The collection files are written, but the report Markdown does not expose the actor directory or a navigable summary.

expect: each relationship axis exposes actor/project n, denominator, source, and window
missing project observed data yields not_comparable rather than a directional conclusion
stale consent-only notice is not emitted for inferred public actor selection

go_for: masked contribution generation without raw email
required_next_fixes: make merge-inclusive versus non-merge populations explicit and internally reconcilable
implement and test public contributor-to-commit/author attachment with coverage and ambiguity
make named-public empty cohort an explicit not_available result
make repo --actors output a report-v2 actor collection consumable by align --actor-dir
ensure every relationship axis carries complete basis metadata and suppresses conclusions when one side is not observed
add these cases to automated regression tests and rerun against frozen snapshots
